items.title: Show HN: Dedoomify – AI news, minus the doom
items.contentSnippet:
What if AI failures were described like ordinary software issues? Paste a link to an AI article and dedoomify turns down the apocalypse: "the model is misaligned" becomes "the model has a bug".
Less Skynet. More software. And every change is highlighted with the original text one hover or tap away. You can try an example without signing up or installing anything!

items.title: Show HN: Airlock, which sandboxes AI agents, is available on the Mac App Store
items.contentSnippet:
Now that Airlock is available on the Mac App Store, I thought it was worth a resubmission. Quickly run your AI agents (Claude, Codex) in a disposable VM. Block the agent from making requests to unknown or untrusted hosts, and get a log of everything that it does - then only bring back the changes you actually want.
It's free, and has no tracking or analytics. It requires a Mac with Apple silicon running macOS 26+
